sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Security Holographic Cold Foil Printing of Collectible Trading Cards

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Alliance Additional Protocol (2016), Investment Chapter (Colombia-Mexico-Peru-Chile)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Governing instruments: (i) Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. incorporation and commercial substance); (ii) Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), notably arts. 25-50, 90, 106 and 353-425; (iii) Decreto 1074 de 2015 (single commercial regulatory decree covering name clearance and mercantile registry); (iv) Law 526 of 1999, as amended by Law 1121 of 2006 (UIAF creation and SARLAFT doctrine); (v) Law 2155 of 2021, art. 59, and DIAN Resolución 2854 de 2021 (beneficiario final reporting to DIAN through MUISCA); (vi) SIC Resolución 164 de 2020 (beneficial owner registration in the RUES at the Cámara de Comercio); (vii) Decreto 1674 de 2016 (definition of PEPs); (viii) UIAF Circular 04 de 2020 (suspicious transaction reporting); (ix) Law 1762 de 2015 (AML criminal provisions). A conservative internal client-intake screening threshold of 5% participation is recommended for the AML file even though the statutory RUES beneficial-owner threshold is 25%.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder) from the foreign shareholder and each UBO to the local incorporator or registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of origin of the UBO/shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the origin state; consular legalization at a Colombian consulate if the origin state is not an Apostille party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (equivalent to Certificate of Good Standing) of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry in the shareholder's constituent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization depending on Convention membership of the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport pages of each UBO, director and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where required by the Cámara de Comercio; simple notarization accepted for the AML file

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or equivalent credit verification from a licensed financial institution in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization of the signatory capacity only

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of physical address of each UBO (utility bill, municipal registration or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or municipal registry in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy with apostille where demanded by enhanced due diligence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration Form conforming to SIC Resolución 164 de 2020 (Beneficiario Final registry through RUES)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company representatives filed electronically with the Cámara de Comercio through the RUES portal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Electronic internal filing; no notarization or apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against (i) OFAC SDN List; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) UIAF money-laundering prevention lists; (iv) domestic PEP databases maintained by the Procuraduría General de la Nación, Contraloría General de la República and Fiscalía General; and (v) the PEP framework of Decreto 1674 de 2016. Screening occurs at onboarding, before each capital contribution or dividend disbursement, and at least quarterly thereafter. Adverse hits must trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds documentation and, where warranted, a UIAF Suspicious Transaction Report within 15 calendar days. Results are archived in the SARLAFT compliance file for a minimum of five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) at www.rues.org.co, processed locally through the Cámara de Comercio del domicilio (commonly the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá at www.ccb.org.co) and the Ventanilla Única Empresarial / Empresas en un Día platform at www.tramitesempresariales.com
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Spanish using the Latin alphabet. Foreign-language or foreign-source names are admitted only when transliterated into the Latin alphabet with Spanish orthography. The statutory suffix 'S.A.S.' must form part of the registered denomination under Article 3 of Law 1258 of 2008. Names consisting solely of a trademark, personal names or numerals are registrable provided they do not mislead as to corporate type or regulated activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written denial by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant has five (5) business days to: (1) file a reconsideration request (recurso de reposición) with the issuing Cámara, attaching supporting evidence and up to three alternative name options; (2) where denial rests on a prohibited or sensitive token, submit the prior authorization of the competent sectoral authority (e.g., Superintendencia Financiera for financial tokens, SIC for trademark-conflicting names); (3) file a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, which must be decided within 30 business days under Ley 1437 de 2011; and (4) simultaneously reserve alternative names through the RUES channel without forfeiting the original reservation while the appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this low-risk trading-cards publishing segment provided the registered domicile is a fixed, verifiable physical address within the jurisdiction of the Cámara de Comercio; postal boxes are prohibited. A virtual-office arrangement with a licensed Colombian service provider is accepted for registry purposes, but the company must maintain accessible corporate records, a Colombian address for service of process, and a local representative for tax and procedural notifications under Código de Comercio arts. 90 and 106 and Decreto 1074 de 2015. ISIC 3240 printing/publishing activities impose no physical-plant or warehouse statutory requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified as low: estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical verification visit by the Cámara de Comercio or SIC under the SIIC control program is below 5%; cumulative probability within the first five fiscal years is approximately 12-15%. DIAN supervisory activity for this sector is predominantly documentary and electronic; a physical visit is triggered mainly by inconsistencies in RUT, UBO or invoicing data.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonymy certificate (Certificado de homonimia) for the proposed S.A.S. denomination
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff for certificates and name clearance, approximately COP 8,000-12,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille of six corporate/UBO documents in the country of origin of the foreign shareholder and UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaries and competent apostille authorities in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing official tariffs in the origin jurisdiction, estimated USD 25-35 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled corporate documents (approximately six pages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator registered with the Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 25-35 per page for official sworn translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial fee for authentication of the incorporation private document and signature of the local incorporator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff under national fee schedules, approximately COP 100,000-200,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cámara de Comercio registration and legalization of the S.A.S., including registration of the certificate of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory minimum registration tariff applicable to S.A.S. with non-resident shareholders, plus book registration fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Electronic filing of the Beneficiario Final (UBO) declaration in the RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio via RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Included in the registration tariff; no incremental statutory charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT and NIT pre-incorporation registration with the DIAN (including MUISCA online processing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory charge for RUT/NIT issuance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Régimen de las Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas) in conjunction with Articles 98 and 110 of the Colombian Commerce Code (Código de Comercio)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce) operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) electronic portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed) registered with the Chamber of Commerce; no public deed is required for S.A.S.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The subscribed capital may be paid in full or in installments over a maximum of two (2) years. No escrow or bank deposit is required prior to registration; capital amounts and payment terms must be stated in the by-laws.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BOARD RESOLUTION No. 1: The undersigned board members, meeting on the date stated below, unanimously resolve: (1) to adopt the corporate by-laws and to ratify the subscription of the issued shares as recorded in the capital subscription schedule; (2) to adopt the registered office address set out in the certificate of incorporation; (3) to appoint the legal representative, financial officer, and statutory auditor; (4) to authorize the opening of corporate bank accounts and the issuance of electronic signature certificates; and (5) to approve the filing of all commercial and fiscal registrations. This resolution is effective immediately and shall be recorded in the corporate minutes in accordance with Law 1258 of 2008.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local) through the RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the RUES website or the local Chamber of Commerce electronic system, submit the proposed corporate name, and request the negative name certificate. The system will automatically issue a certificate confirming that no existing entity uses the same or confusingly similar name. Signed by the legal representative or appointed attorney using the digital certificate.
required_dossiers: Legal representative's or attorney's proof of identity (cédula/passport)
Number, if applicable, of proxy (poder) for non-resident shareholders
Completed online name search form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged as confusingly similar, the applicant may submit a reconsideration request to the Chamber, or modify the name and re-run the search process. A new name search incurs a nominal processing fee after a first free rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of the S.A.S. incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chamber of Commerce (private document protocol) or optional Notary (for public instrument when required by shareholders)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation document in compliance with Law 1258 of 2008, ensuring it contains the corporate purpose, capital structure, share classes, shareholder rights, governance rules, and administrator powers. All founding shareholders or their legal representatives must sign the document, either physically before a notary or electronically using certified digital signatures. Once signed, the document becomes the company's by-laws.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws in Spanish
Shareholders' identification documents (passports for non-residents)
Name availability certificate (from Step 1)
Legal entity shareholder: corporate charter and legal representation certificate apostilled
Certificate of foreign registration for a foreign company (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber returns a correction request (requerimiento), the shareholders must execute a private deed of correction and resubmit the document through the same electronic portal. No additional filing fee is charged for the first correction; after the second correction, the standard registry tariff applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce and issuance of incorporation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local) – Registry Office and RUES electronic payment gateway
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation document and required annexes through the RUES portal. Trigger the payment of the registration tariff using the reference number generated by the system. The Chamber's legal reviewer will verify the document's compliance with Law 1258 and the Commerce Code, after which the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) is issued electronically.
required_dossiers: Incorporation document signed by all shareholders
Name availability certificate
Payment of registration fee (receiveable) and form RUES (Formulario Adicional de Registro)
Copy of shareholders' identities and representative capacities
Certificate of compliance with anti-money laundering background checks
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration application is rejected, the applicant must correct the non-compliant item within 30 days. The Chamber will issue a correction notice specifying the exact legal deficiency. Corrected documents may be refiled without additional fees unless the deficiency involves a substantive capital or by-law change requiring a new registration act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax and fiscal registration with the national tax administration (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – electronic system (SIE, Sistema de Información Electrónica)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation to the DIAN online platform, complete the pre-registration data, and obtain the single tax identification number (NIT). The system will assign the tax responsibilities, including income and complement taxes, VAT, and national consumption tax. Obtain the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) and verify that the ISIC code 3240 and the description of the printing activity are correctly included.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued by the Chamber
Power of attorney or ID of the legal representative
RUT pre-registration form completed online
Sworn statement of the exact commercial activity (printing of collectible trading cards)
Proof of email and telephone contact information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DIAN queries the application due to mismatches in the RUT or capital data, the legal representative may file an electronic correction request. In case of a denial, an appeal (recurso de reconsideración) may be filed before the DIAN Central Office within 60 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal operating permit and social security employer registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal – Secretaría de Hacienda; social security system operators (ARP, EPS, AFP) managing the mandatory contributive system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the municipal tax authority for the Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA) using the RUT and incorporation certificate. Obtain the Registro de Industria y Comercio and any local operating permits required for the registered address. Simultaneously, download and submit the employer registration form to the social security network (Providencia) to obtain the employer's social security number and enroll in the work risk insurer (ARL).
required_dossiers: RUT with ICA responsibilities selected
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
Lease contract or title deed of the registered office
Bank account details for employer contributions
Local zoning certificate confirming the address is suitable for printing activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal permit is denied due to zoning, fire safety, or environmental restrictions, the company may file a corrective submission with the corresponding municipal planning office, including a compliance plan prepared by a licensed architect or environmental consultant. The appeal must be resolved within 60 working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría de Hacienda and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for consumer safety and commercial compliance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Municipal de Industria y Comercio and municipal operating permit (Funcionamiento Industrial)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) of the district jurisdiction, acting under the Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II – Environmental Registration (Declaración Ambiental) and emissions permit; full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is not required for low-impact graphic printing activities under Decree 1076 of 2015 and Resolution 0776 of 2021, provided production does not exceed the small-printing threshold of 500 kg/day of raw material processing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must meet the permissible limits of Resolution 0631 of 2015 (pH 6.0–9.0, total suspended solids < 150 mg/L, and COD < 180 mg/L); atmospheric VOC emissions from printing inks and coatings must comply with Resolution 0909 of 2008; hazardous solid waste (solvents, ink containers, and chemical wipes) must be managed under Resolution 1407 of 2006 and Decree 4741 of 2005, requiring a hazardous waste transporter registration and final disposal certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the local Cuerpo de Bomberos (fire brigade) after mandatory inspection of the premises; structural load certificate signed by a licensed civil engineer confirming that the printing machinery can be safely supported; electrical installation certificate prepared by an authorized electrician for the industrial power supply; occupational health and safety clearance under the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) required by Decree 1072 of 2015, including an employer affiliation to a professional risk insurance (ARL) and a medical and hygiene protocol for workers exposed to inks, airborne particulates, and noise.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - sole Colombian authority for national taxes, customs and foreign trade. Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic registration and filing services: MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co); e-invoicing validation platform: RADIAN e-invoice register.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned Colombian S.A.S. must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and RUT (Registro Único Tributario) as follows: (1) incorporate the S.A.S. by private written document registered in the local Cámara de Comercio - the Chamber's 'Sociedades en Línea' service automatically assigns a provisional NIT; (2) within the statutory month after incorporation, the legal representative (domiciled in Colombia) must access MUISCA and officially activate the NIT by submitting the complementary RUT data, electing the responsibility codes for income tax ('D-11 contribuyente declarante de renta y complementarios'), VAT common regime ('I-04 responsable del IVA'), and foreign trade ('C-44' where applicable); (3) in parallel, register in the VUCE (Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior) with DIAN customs and obtain the exporter registration for the physical exports of printed trading cards; (4) a foreign juridical person without local establishment obtains a non-resident NIT through a Colombian fiscal agent filing the RUT in MUISCA with a power of attorney and certificate of incorporation; (5) after RUT activation the S.A.S. must be habilitated for electronic invoicing in the same MUISCA module before issuing any sales document.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - a S.A.S. is a separate juridical person (Law 1258/2008, C. Co. Arts. 98-106) with limited liability; for tax purposes it is a resident legal entity (régimen común) taxed in its own name under the Colombian income tax regime (E.T. Arts. 20-27, 55, 240). Tax base: worldwide net income with foreign tax credit for taxes paid abroad on foreign-source income; Colombian-source income from the local printing and card publishing operations is fully taxable at the 35% CIT rate (2025 fiscal year). The S.A.S. has no pass-through or disregarded-entity classification and no territorial election; non-resident shareholders receiving dividends incur an additional withholding of 20% on the post-CIT dividend (remittance tax), and the 35% corporate rate plus the 20% shareholder-level levy approximate an aggregate 48% effective tax on distributed profits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no 'check-the-box' entity election; classification is fixed by statute and substance. Available optional elections for this manufacturing exporter: (1) adoption of the optional aggregated tax regime 'Régimen Simple de Tributación - SIMPLE' (E.T. Art. 908, Law 2010/2019) for legal entities with prior-year gross revenue up to COP 3,500 million, replacing income tax, VAT surcharge and municipal industry-and-commerce tax with a single SIMPLE payment - election must be filed in MUISCA before 31 January of the effective year, is irrevocable for at least 2 years, and is generally unsuitable for a capital-intensive export manufacturer because SIMPLE's presumptive revenue-based charge does not allow full deduction for cost of exported goods nor equivalent carry-forward of input VAT credits; (2) fiscal consolidation (E.T. Arts. 29-31 and Decree 1874/2021) permitting a head S.A.S. owning more than 50% of Colombian subsidiaries to apply to DIAN for consolidated national income tax (a group-level election binding for 3 years); (3) the neutrality vehicle regime (E.T. Arts. 35-38) available for S.A.S. vehicles dedicated to share acquisition in Colombian companies; (4) classification of foreign subsidiaries under the Colombian controlled foreign corporation (CFC) rules (E.T. Art. 882) is by a functional analog method without elective recharacterisation; (5) free trade zone user election ('usuario industrial de Zona Franca') may be sought for the printed-card production flow, conferring reduced CIT of 20% and favourable export VAT treatments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (the Colombian Central Bank), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) in the administration of the exchange control regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating currency regime under a statutory foreign-exchange market (Mercado Cambiario, MCR). Current-account operations (exports, imports, services, royalties, dividends, interest) are freely convertible and channeled through authorized local intermediaries, subject to exchange-declaration reporting. Capital-account operations (foreign direct investment, foreign loans, portfolio investment) are likewise permitted without exchange licenses, but must be registered with the Banco de la República and reported on the corresponding foreign investment forms. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are legal and unrestricted provided the foreign investment has been duly registered and all applicable Colombian corporate and dividend taxes have been settled; no prior administrative authorization is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports, the exporter must repatriate and channel the foreign-currency proceeds through an authorized Colombian bank within six (6) months from the date of the export customs declaration; this term may be extended under the rules of the Banco de la República. Service exports generally enjoy a collection period of up to twelve (12) months. There is no mandatory conversion ratio; Colombian law does not force exporters to sell foreign exchange to the central bank. The exporter may lawfully maintain export collections in a foreign-currency deposit account either in Colombia or abroad, but any conversion into Colombian pesos must be executed through the authorized exchange market and recorded on the corresponding exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio) as a channeled foreign-exchange transaction.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Non-resident digital EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex, or other offshore electronic-money institutions cannot operate as deposit-taking entities in Colombia and are not participants in the regulated Mercado Cambiario. They may be used only as auxiliary payment notification tools or ancillary collection collectors, but cannot serve as the primary treasury clearing rail or provide lawful FX channeling for Colombian export proceeds. A locally licensed SEDPE (Sociedad Especializada en Depósito y Pago Electrónico) or a regulated local bank remains mandatory for lawful foreign-exchange settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permissible under Colombian Sarlaft (Anti-Money Laundering) and the SFC's rules for low-risk legal entities, and physical attendance at a branch in Colombia is not a statutory condition. In practice, top-tier banks will require at least one enhanced videoconference interview with the legal representative or the designated compliance officer, plus apostilled corporate documents, notarized powers of attorney, and a verified certificate of existence and representation. Banks retain full discretion to request an in-person branch meeting for non-resident directors or complex shareholding structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident corporate ownership with a recently incorporated S.A.S. structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of incorporation, current bylaws, full shareholders registry, updated UBO (beneficial-ownership) declaration, notarized and apostilled power of attorney for the local representative, corporate resolution authorizing account opening, and a sworn statement of lawful source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border invoicing to/from collectible-card markets or trading platforms without clear underlying operative documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial contracts with global distributors, authenticated purchase orders, pro-forma invoices, warehouse receipts, bills of lading or air waybills, customs export declarations, bankable evidence of the underlying commercial reality, and audited trial balances demonstrating operational consistency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unregistered foreign direct investment and imminent large international wire transfers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of existing RUT (Registro Único Tributario), initial foreign-investment registration filings, anticipated declaration of the channeled capital, shareholder meeting minutes approving the capital injection, and a fully executed subscription-and-payment agreement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of historic financial statements or short lifecycle of the operating subsidiary
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Opening-date balance sheet, projected cash-flow and budget model, estimated P&L for first 12 months, compliance with local accounting standards (NIC/NIIF as applicable), and tax filings or negative-tax declarations (Formulario 100 or 110) evidencing exposure to the Colombian tax administration.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from the foreign parent must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 to the company's designated operational account at the chosen Tier-1 Colombian bank. The wire must reference the official foreign-investment purpose code corresponding to direct foreign equity participation (Registro de Inversión Internacional Directa) and the bank will deliver a certificado de canalización evidencing lawful entry into the exchange market. Within twelve (12) months of the transaction, the company must submit the Declaración de Registro de Inversión Internacional (Formulario No. 7) to the Banco de la República, updating the foreign investment registry and thereby securing future unrestricted dividend repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for printing substrates, foils, security components, tooling, royalties, and service fees to non-resident counterparties will be cleared through SWIFT MT103 for direct and immediate settlement, or through an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (LC) sight or usance for larger raw-material procurement. Each disbursement must be identified with the corresponding import customs declaration, the underlying invoice and contract, and the appropriate exchange-declaration form (Formulario No. 4 / No. 5 / No. 6, as applicable), filed by the local bank to keep the central bank's foreign-exchange records accurate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD outright forwards (via authorized local intermediaries)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) with maturity alignment to payment and collection cycles
Cross-currency swaps between COP and USD for medium-term treasury positions
FX options (European-style) as permitted risk-overlay instruments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through March 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a supplementary penalty on the variable tariff, suspension of good-standing certificate, inability to obtain pending transaction certificates, and administrative strike-off if renewal is omitted for two consecutive years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Asamblea General de Accionistas – Financial Statement Approval and Management Discharge
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minutes book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days after the 31 December fiscal year-end (no later than March 1)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the shareholders' meeting within the legal term can result in fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades of up to 50 SMMLV per infringement and loss of limitation of liability for undisclosed acts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Depósito de Estados Financieros (Annual Financial Statements Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the mercantile registry renewal, due by March 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Missing the deposit obstructs the registry renewal, suspends issuance of commercial certificates, and exposes the company to fines from the Superintendencia de Sociedades for non-compliance with corporate disclosure obligations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year-end 31 December; electronic return due according to the DIAN calendar assigned by the last two digits of the NIT, ordinarily between April and May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% monthly interest on the unpaid tax, subject to a 100% cap, plus default interest; repeated non-filing can trigger the administrative dissolution procedure and freeze financial transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually based on the DIAN technical resolution, generally between May and June of the year following the tax period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties for omission or error per record up to 20,000 UVT (approximately USD 1,200 in 2024) plus a 10% penalty for defective records, with reductions for prompt correction.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Annual Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation before July 1 or within the deadline stated in the DIAN resolution; any substantial shareholding transfer must be updated within 30 calendar days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with UBO declaration imposes fines up to 30,000 UVT per taxpayer, suspension of the RUT, and restrictions on obtaining commercial registry certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory independent audit (revisor fiscal) is mandatory when the company's total assets equal or exceed 5,000 SMMLV, or gross annual revenues equal or exceed 3,000 SMMLV, or the entity employs more than 50 workers; otherwise the S.A.S. may operate with optional or no revisor fiscal subject to shareholder consent.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (Group 1) for large or publicly listed companies; IFRS for SMEs (Group 2) under Decree 2420 of 2015 for most S.A.S. entities; simplified local accounting for micro-sized entities under the Grupo 3 regime.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) holding 10% or more of capital, voting rights, or effective control must be identified and updated in the public commercial registry records; annual confirmation to DIAN is required through the beneficial-owner declaration form, and any transfer of shareholding or change of control must be reported within 30 calendar days of the transaction.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200–3,500 for an SME review; USD 3,500–8,000 for a full IFRS certified audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions for ISIC 3240 activity. Standard deductions apply (interest, depreciation, labor expenses). Reduced rates only apply to free-zone users, which do not cover the stated printing operation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios; mandatory electronic filing through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: DIAN sets an annual national calendar. For calendar-year taxpayers, the deadline typically falls between early April and late April of the following tax year, based on the last two digits of the NIT. Fiscal-year-end entities must file within the month designated by DIAN, generally no later than 6–9 months after year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenues from the sale of collectible trading cards and printing services, before deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Colombian-source gross income; export income from foreign customers must be included on the same line if title passes in Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income after ordinary deductions. Loss carryforwards should be applied against this line with the 25% annual limit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident branch or permanent establishment, apply only allocable domestic expenses; ensure transfer pricing adjustments are made to this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed at the 35% statutory rate on Renta Líquida Gravable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with a PE are taxed on income attributable to the Colombian PE. For purely passive receipt of Colombian-source income, use Formulario 110 as withholding return only when required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 72 – Total Impuesto a Cargo / Saldo a Favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax liability after tax credits and prepayments. Positive amount constitutes tax due; negative amount becomes a tax credit carried forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE should not merge the parent’s foreign tax credit into this line unless permitted by an applicable DTA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% per month or fraction on the tax due, capped at 100% of the tax due. If the return is filed before the DIAN has issued a citation, a reduced extemporaneous penalty of 10% of the tax may apply. There is also a minimum fine of 10 UVTs for returns with no tax due. Late payment interest is charged at the rate published by the DIAN, broadly equal to the current bank benchmark plus 2.5 points.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed to non-resident corporate and individual recipients from profits that have already been subject to corporate income tax; a higher rate applies when the profit pool had not previously paid corporate income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must supply a current Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by its residence country, legalized/apostilled, together with a statement of beneficial ownership and resident status. The Colombian S.A.S. must retain this documentation and file it with the DIAN via the ‘Información de Tratamientos de Contratos y Convenios’ annex in the electronic declaration. Under most Colombian DTAs, the dividend withholding rate is reduced to 5% or 10% depending on shareholding (typically 5% for at least 15–25% shareholding, otherwise 10%). DIAN may verify the certificate; if not in place at the date of distribution, the statutory 10% withholding applies, and a refund can be claimed later.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: royalties for patents, trademarks and technical IP are subject to 15% withholding; interest paid to foreign banks and financial institutions is subject to 15% withholding (reduced to 5% for certain long-term external credit loans of five years or more). Treaty rates commonly reduce royalty and interest withholding to 5% or 10% if the DTA contains a royalties article and authorizes the reduced rate for interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File / Master File documentation for taxpayers with gross revenues or gross assets exceeding 100,000 UVTs (approximately COP 4.7 billion for fiscal year 2024) and that have transactions with foreign related parties exceeding 10,000 UVTs per related party. A simpler characterization report (Declaración Informativa de Precio de Transferencia, Formulario 120) is required when revenues or assets are at least 50,000 UVTs.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not maintain a separate Economic Substance Regulation (ESR) in the Gulf-country sense, but the substantive business requirement is enforced through the generally anticipated anti-avoidance rule (‘Abuso en Materia Tributaria’) and the corporate law doctrine of ‘desestimación de la personalidad jurídica.’ To pass, the S.A.S. must have its own office, operational staff, contracts, bank accounts and decision-making authority in Colombia; a purely holding or invoicing entity without commercial substance will be recharacterized and may be subject to 200% surcharge on underpaid income tax plus interest.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting income, invoicing less than the true contract price, using integral fake expenses, or maintaining undisclosed foreign bank accounts to reduce Colombian-sourced profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prison sentence of 4 to 9 years under Article 356 of the Colombian Criminal Code, plus a fine equal to 100%–150% of the evaded tax. Civil administrative penalty may increase the evaded tax by 200% plus default interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who authorise false declarations become personally liable; the corporate veil is pierced for restitution, and the enforcing court may issue travel bans and detention orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the S.A.S. as an invoice conduit with no substantial business activity, minimal staff, no operational control, and all commercial decisions taken from a non-resident shareholder’s jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN is empowered to disregard the corporate entity under the general anti-abuse rule, reallocate all income to the controlling non-resident, impose the 200% punitive understatement penalty, and disallow deductions for sham transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly maintain a shell structure risk joint and several liability for the full tax deficiency; a civil asset freeze and a prohibition on leaving Colombia can be imposed during the investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold and Pay Dividend/Royalty Tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends or paying royalty fees to a non-resident without deducting the required withholding tax, or applying a treaty rate without the necessary Tax Residence Certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The S.A.S. becomes personally liable as withholding agent for the entire underpament plus interest and a 20% late-payment penalty per month (capped at 100%). If the omission exceeds 1,000 UVTs, criminal liability for tax evasion attaches.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives who sign distribution minutes without knowing the beneficial owner’s residence are personally liable for the unpaid withholding; travel bans and disqualification from conducting commercial activities for up to 10 years may apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling collectible trading cards to a foreign related party at a margin inconsistent with the arm’s length principle and failing to file the TP information return or to prepare Local and Master Files.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN will re-determine the taxable income at market price and impose a 75% understatement penalty on the additional tax attributed to the gap; the taxpayer also forfeits any right to carry forward losses that underlie the manipulated transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the TP penalty when they have signed the related party agreements or knowingly submit incomplete TP documentation; imprisonment is available when the penalty exceeds 1,500 UVTs and intent to evade is proven.
